title: David Fincher is being dragged for suspected use of AI in his latest film
description: Though David Fincher's fans had been eagerly anticipating The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, early screenings of the Once Upon a Time in Hollywood sequel starring Brad Pitt have raised questions about whether generative AI was used in the film.
